properties.decision: Not decided. Recorded as brainstorming, not as a proposal.
properties.name: OPEN — should reasoning_report name a claim whose only support is one witness's own statement, and should evidence grades (reliability, credibility) change how strongly an objection contests a claim?
properties.rationale:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. From the public legal-case trial's F4 (2026-10-25):
- Self-serving testimony graded C/3 contested a claim exactly as a document graded A/1 did.
- reasoning_report lists `rests_on` but never says "this claim's only support is one witness". The agent found that by hand, and it was the most important weak point.

Two questions:
(1) A computed "single point of support" reading: the claim's support collapses to one evidence record, or one speaker, with no independent corroboration. This is cheap: a walk over rests_on, and it needs the witness of dec:idea-testimony-has-a-witness-and-its-own-dates to say "one speaker".
(2) Grades weigh. Options: (a) no change to truth, but the report ranks contests by the opposing evidence's grade; (b) an objection below a grade threshold is read "weak" and named apart; (c) grades enter the truth reading.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS:
- (c) puts a judgement (credibility) into a computed reading; reflow2 has kept grades as a read-back that "changes no truth" on purpose (add_requirement's confidence: "Read back; changes no truth").
- Weighing credibility is the fact-finder's job in law, not the tool's. (a) informs without deciding.
Cost: (1) is small; (2c) is large and contested.
